data.message: I opt in to 18 tons individually, not contingent on unanimity. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100—not guaranteed recovery or optimal long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Will you opt in?

I propose a 10-ton limit per fisher. If all 25 follow it, 250 tons remain and the lake returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome—supporting $10,000 each every month indefinitely. Larger collective catches risk reduced future stock or collapse. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support the cap.
